title: MoonDial
description: A completely working named resource pack for clocks. Full Spanish support!
body:
This is a Resource Pack that, when you rename a Clock, will show you the current phase of the moon. 

**the following names apply;**
MoonDial, moon dial, moondial, slimecheck.

_This Resource Pack has full Spanish Support_

Este es un paquete de recursos que, al cambiar el nombre de un reloj, le mostrará la fase actual de la luna. 

**Se aplican los siguientes nombres:**
reloj de luna, reloj luna

spanish translation done by Google Translate
